Huineng on awakening

Huineng (638–713) approaches awakening within Chan Buddhism. He emphasized direct insight into one's nature and nonattachment to fixed forms, including attachment to meditation itself. Systematically, the teaching links sudden awakening, nonattachment, mind into a practical and theoretical whole. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets awakening most directly—useful for searches such as “huineng quotes on awakening.”

How to use this page

Start with the shortest passage, then compare tone across sources. Return to the Huineng thinker page for biography and to the awakening theme for other voices on the same question.
